name: Satyr Horns
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
narrative.objectives: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.
narrative.offerRewardText:
These are perfect, adventurer! Thanks for helping me out!

Oh, and this is for your time...
narrative.requestItemsText: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, adventurer. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
